-- [Emissary prelude] SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.QBinomial — verbatim (imports stripped)
namespace SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The Gaussian binomial coefficient `n choose k` with parameter `q`.

The chosen recurrence is
`[n+1,k+1]_q = [n,k]_q + q^(k+1) [n,k+1]_q`, the form used by the
prime-power layer argument. -/
def qBinom (q : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | _ + 1, 0 => 1
  | n + 1, k + 1 => qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)

@[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_zero (q : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_succ (q k : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 (k + 1) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_zero (q n : ℕ) : qBinom q (n + 1) 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    qBinom q (n + 1) (k + 1) =
      qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1) := rfl

theorem qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (q : ℕ) : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → qBinom q n k = 0
  | 0, 0, h => by omega
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by simp
  | _ + 1, 0, h => by omega
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      have hnk : n < k := by omega
      have hnks : n < k + 1 := by omega
      simp [qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnk, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnks]

@[simp] theorem qBinom_self (q : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, qBinom q n n = 1
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      simp [qBinom_self q n, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

/-- The Pascal recurrence in the indexing used in the manuscript. -/
theorem qBinom_pascal (q : ℕ) {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q (n - 1) (k - 1) + q ^ k * qBinom q (n - 1) k := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  simpa using qBinom_succ_succ q n k

/-- The product `(q-1)(q²-1)⋯(qⁿ-1)`. -/
def qFactorial (q n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (q ^ (i + 1) - 1)

@[simp] theorem qFactorial_zero (q : ℕ) : qFactorial q 0 = 1 := by
  simp [qFactorial]

theorem qFactorial_succ (q n : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q (n + 1) = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
  simp [qFactorial, Finset.prod_range_succ]

theorem qFactorial_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (n : ℕ) : 0 < qFactorial q n := by
  rw [qFactorial]
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i hi ↦ by
    have hiq : 1 < q ^ (i + 1) := by
      exact one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega

private theorem pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one {q a b : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (q ^ a - 1) + q ^ a * (q ^ b - 1) = q ^ (a + b) - 1 := by
  have ha : 1 ≤ q ^ a := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hb : 1 ≤ q ^ b := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hab : q ^ a ≤ q ^ a * q ^ b := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (q ^ a) hb
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, mul_one, add_comm]
  exact tsub_add_tsub_cancel hab ha

/-- The division-free Gaussian factorial identity. -/
theorem qBinom_mul_qFactorials {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n →
      qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) = qFactorial q n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst k
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
          have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
          by_cases htop : k = n
          · subst k
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qBinom_self,
              qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
            simp [qFactorial_succ]
          · have hklt : k < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hkn htop
            have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ n := by omega
            have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qFactorial_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, hsub,
              qFactorial_succ]
            calc
              (qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q k * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - (k + 1) + 1) - 1)) =
                  (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) *
                      (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) *
                      (qBinom q n (k + 1) * qFactorial q (k + 1) *
                        qFactorial q (n - (k + 1))) *
                      (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                        rw [qFactorial_succ, hsub, qFactorial_succ]
                        ring
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                      rw [ih hkn, ih hk1]
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
                    have hexp : k + 1 + (n - k) = n + 1 := by omega
                    calc
                      qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                          q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) =
                          qFactorial q n * ((q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                            q ^ (k + 1) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) := by ring
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ ((k + 1) + (n - k)) - 1) := by
                        rw [pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one (by omega)]
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by rw [hexp]
              _ = qFactorial q (n + 1) := by rw [qFactorial_succ]

/-- Symmetry of Gaussian binomial coefficients. -/
theorem qBinom_symm {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q n (n - k) := by
  have hleft := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  have hright := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq (Nat.sub_le n k)
  rw [tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le hk] at hright
  have hden : 0 < qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) :=
    Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hden
  calc
    qBinom q n k * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) = qFactorial q n := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hleft
    _ = qBinom q n (n - k) * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hright.symm

/-- The usual product formula, stated in `ℚ` to make the division exact. -/
theorem qBinom_cast_eq_qFactorial_div {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) =
      qFactorial q n / (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
  have hden : (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))))
  apply (eq_div_iff hden).2
  simpa [mul_assoc] using (show
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) * (qFactorial q k : ℚ) *
      (qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) = (qFactorial q n : ℚ) by
        exact_mod_cast qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk)



/-- Ordered linearly independent `k`-frames in a module. -/
abbrev LinearIndependentFrames (K V : Type*) [Semiring K] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module K V]
    (k : ℕ) :=
  {s : Fin k → V // LinearIndependent K s}

/-- The type of `k`-dimensional subspaces. -/
abbrev FinrankSubspaces (K V : Type*) [Semiring K] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module K V]
    (k : ℕ) :=
  {W : Submodule K V // Module.finrank K W = k}

private theorem span_coe_frame_eq_submodule
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (k : ℕ) (W : Submodule K V) (s : Fin k → W)
    (hs : LinearIndependent K s) (hW : Module.finrank K W = k) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ (s i : V)) = W := by
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range s) = ⊤ :=
    hs.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp [hW])
  change Submodule.span K (Set.range (W.subtype ∘ s)) = W
  rw [Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span, htop, Submodule.map_top,
    Submodule.range_subtype]

/-- A linearly independent frame is equivalently a subspace together with a
linearly independent frame which spans that subspace. -/
noncomputable def linearIndependentFramesEquiv
    (K V : Type*) [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (k : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependentFrames K V k ≃
      Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k := by
  let forward : LinearIndependentFrames K V k →
      Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k := fun s ↦
    ⟨⟨Submodule.span K (Set.range s.1), by
        simpa using finrank_span_eq_card s.2⟩,
      ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨s.1 i, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩,
        linearIndependent_span s.2⟩⟩
  let backward : (Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
      LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) → LinearIndependentFrames K V k := fun x ↦
    ⟨fun i ↦ (x.2.1 i : V),
      x.2.2.map' x.1.1.subtype (Submodule.ker_subtype x.1.1)⟩
  refine Equiv.ofBijective forward ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s t hst
    have := congrArg backward hst
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val this)
  · intro x
    refine ⟨backward x, ?_⟩
    rcases x with ⟨W, s⟩
    have hfirst : (forward (backward ⟨W, s⟩)).1 = W :=
      Subtype.ext (span_coe_frame_eq_submodule k W.1 s.1 s.2 W.2)
    have hsub :
        Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ ((s.1 i : W.1) : V)) = W.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hfirst
    apply Sigma.ext hfirst
    simp only [forward, backward]
    apply (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_heq ?_ ?_).2
    · apply Function.hfunext rfl
      intro i j hij
      have hij' : i = j := eq_of_heq hij
      subst j
      apply (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq ?_).2
      · rfl
      · intro x
        change x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ ((s.1 i : W.1) : V)) ↔ x ∈ W.1
        rw [hsub]
    · exact congrArg (fun U : Submodule K V ↦ Fin k → U) hsub
    · apply Function.hfunext
        (congrArg (fun U : Submodule K V ↦ Fin k → U) hsub)
      intro x y hxy
      congr! 2
      funext z
      rw [hsub]

/-- The number of ordered independent `k`-frames in an `n`-dimensional
vector space over a field of cardinality `q`. -/
def frameProd (q n k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i : Fin k, (q ^ n - q ^ i.val)

@[simp] theorem frameProd_zero (q n : ℕ) : frameProd q n 0 = 1 := by
  simp [frameProd]

theorem frameProd_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    frameProd q n (k + 1) = frameProd q n k * (q ^ n - q ^ k) := by
  rw [frameProd, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [frameProd]

/-- The product of the powers of `q` which are factored out of an ordered
frame count. -/
def framePower (q k : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin k, q ^ i.val

@[simp] theorem framePower_zero (q : ℕ) : framePower q 0 = 1 := by
  simp [framePower]

theorem framePower_succ (q k : ℕ) :
    framePower q (k + 1) = framePower q k * q ^ k := by
  rw [framePower, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [framePower]

private theorem pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    q ^ n - q ^ k = q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [show n = k + (n - k) by omega]
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
  simp

/-- Clearing the denominator in the ordered-frame product formula. -/
theorem frameProd_mul_qFactorial {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
      framePower q k * qFactorial q n := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
      have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [frameProd_succ, pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub hkn, framePower_succ]
      calc
        frameProd q n k * (q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) *
              qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) =
            q ^ k * (frameProd q n k *
              (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1))) := by ring
        _ = q ^ k * (frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
          rw [hsub, qFactorial_succ]
        _ = q ^ k * (framePower q k * qFactorial q n) := by rw [ih hkn]
        _ = framePower q k * q ^ k * qFactorial q n := by ring

/-- The ordered-frame form of the Gaussian product identity. -/
theorem qBinom_mul_frameProd {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k = frameProd q n k := by
  have hmain := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := n) hk
  have hdiag := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := k) (le_refl k)
  have hqbin := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, qFactorial_zero, mul_one] at hdiag
  have hcancel : 0 < qFactorial q (n - k) := qFactorial_pos hq _
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hcancel
  calc
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
        framePower q k *
          (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
            rw [hdiag]
            ring
    _ = framePower q k * qFactorial q n := by rw [hqbin]
    _ = frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) := hmain.symm

theorem frameProd_pos {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    0 < frameProd q n k := by
  rw [frameProd]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i hi
  have hik : i.val < k := i.isLt
  have hin : i.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hik hk
  exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hin)

theorem card_linearIndependentFrames
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  simpa [frameProd] using card_linearIndependent (K := K) (V := V) hk

/-- The exact number of ordered bases of the standard `r`-space over
`ZMod p`, expressed as the ordered-frame product. -/
theorem card_orderedBases_fin_zmod (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames (ZMod p) (Fin r → ZMod p) r) =
      frameProd p r r := by
  simpa using
    (card_linearIndependentFrames
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin r → ZMod p) (k := r) (by simp))

/-- Counting independent frames by their span. -/
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  letI : Fintype (FinrankSubspaces K V k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    _ = ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro W hW
        symm
        simpa [W.2] using
          (card_linearIndependentFrames (K := K) (V := W.1) (k := k)
            (by simp [W.2]))
    _ = Nat.card (Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := Nat.card_sigma.symm
    _ = Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) :=
      Nat.card_congr (linearIndependentFramesEquiv K V k).symm
    _ = frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_linearIndependentFrames hk

/-- The Gaussian coefficient counts subspaces of a fixed dimension over any
finite division ring. -/
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) =
      qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  have hq : 2 ≤ Fintype.card K := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hpos : 0 < frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := frameProd_pos hq le_rfl
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd hk
    _ = qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k *
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := (qBinom_mul_frameProd hq hk).symm

/-- Exact Gaussian count for subspaces of the standard `n`-space over
`ZMod p`. -/
theorem card_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.card {W : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) //
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) W = k} = qBinom p n k := by
  simpa using
    (card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin n → ZMod p) (k := k) (by simpa using hk))

/-- A subspace together with its dimension, bounded by the ambient
dimension. -/
noncomputable def submoduleEquivSigmaFinrank
    (K V : Type*) [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    Submodule K V ≃
      Σ k : Fin (Module.finrank K V + 1), FinrankSubspaces K V k.val where
  toFun W := ⟨⟨Module.finrank K W, Nat.lt_succ_of_le W.finrank_le⟩, ⟨W, rfl⟩⟩
  invFun x := x.2.1
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    rcases x with ⟨k, W⟩
    rcases W with ⟨W, hW⟩
    have hk : (⟨Module.finrank K W, Nat.lt_succ_of_le W.finrank_le⟩ :
        Fin (Module.finrank K V + 1)) = k := Fin.ext hW
    cases hk
    rfl

/-- The total Gaussian sum. -/
def totalQBinom (q n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), qBinom q n k.val

/-- Pairing dimensions equidistant from the middle in even rank. -/
theorem totalQBinom_even_split {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (a : ℕ) :
    totalQBinom q (2 * a) = qBinom q (2 * a) a +
      2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, qBinom q (2 * a) (a + (j + 1)) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun k ↦ qBinom q (2 * a) k
  have hlow : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a - 1 - j) :=
        (Finset.sum_range_reflect f a).symm
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hja : j < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        dsimp [f]
        rw [qBinom_symm hq (by omega : a - 1 - j ≤ 2 * a)]
        congr 1
        omega
  rw [totalQBinom, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  have hsize : 2 * a + 1 = (a + 1) + a := by omega
  rw [hsize, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_succ, hlow]
  dsimp [f]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]
  ring

/-- Exact count of all subspaces of the standard space over `ZMod p`. -/
theorem card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)) = totalQBinom p n := by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (submoduleEquivSigmaFinrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)),
    Nat.card_sigma]
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) = n := by simp
  rw [hfin]
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin (n + 1), Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) k.val)) =
        ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), qBinom p n k.val := by
    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro k
    exact card_subspaces_fin_zmod p n k.val (by omega)
  simpa only [totalQBinom] using hsum

end SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds

/-- A subgroup of prime index is maximal.  This small lemma is useful below because the
prime-index subgroup is chosen by its cardinality, rather than by a maximality argument. -/
theorem isCoatom_of_prime_index (H : Subgroup G) (hprime : H.index.Prime) : IsCoatom H := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro htop
    exact hprime.ne_one (by simp [htop])
  · intro K hHK
    have hdvd : K.index ∣ H.index := H.index_dvd_of_le hHK.le
    rcases hprime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd K.index hdvd with hK | hK
    · exact Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp hK

      have hrel : H.relIndex K = 1 := by
        apply Nat.mul_right_cancel
          (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite (H := H)))
        simpa [hK] using htower
      exact ((not_le_of_gt hHK) (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp hrel)).elim

/-- In a finite `p`-group, a subgroup of index `p` is normal. -/
theorem normal_of_index_eq_prime_of_isPGroup {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hG : IsPGroup p G) (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p) : H.Normal := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hcard⟩ := hG.exists_card_eq
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.card_pos H.index_dvd_card
    rw [hindex, hcard, hc, pow_zero] at hle
    have := hp.one_lt
    omega
  apply H.normal_of_index_eq_minFac_card
  rw [hindex, hcard, hp.pow_minFac hc]

/-- The fiber of the intersection map across a fixed coatom. -/
abbrev CoatomFiber (M V : Subgroup G) :=
  {Q : Subgroup G // Q ⊓ M = V ∧ ¬ Q ≤ M}

noncomputable local instance coatomFiberFintype (M V : Subgroup G) :
    Fintype (CoatomFiber M V) := Fintype.ofFinite _

/-- All subgroups with a fixed intersection with a normal coatom inject into the corresponding
coset space.  Notice that this statement does not require a `p`-group hypothesis. -/
theorem coatomFiber_card_le_relIndex (M V : Subgroup G) [M.Normal]
    (hM : IsCoatom M) (hVM : V ≤ M) :
    Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) ≤ V.relIndex M := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, -, hxM⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hM.lt_top
  have sup_eq_top (S : Subgroup G) (hS : ¬ S ≤ M) : S ⊔ M = ⊤ := by
    apply (hM.ne_iff_eq_top le_sup_right).mp
    intro hSM
    exact hS (le_sup_left.trans_eq hSM)
  have exists_rep (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : ∃ m : M, x * (m : G) ∈ Q.1 := by
    have hxQM : x ∈ Q.1 ⊔ M := by
      rw [sup_eq_top Q.1 Q.2.2]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top x
    obtain ⟨q, hq, m, hm, hqmx⟩ :=
      (Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_right (s := Q.1) (t := M) (x := x)).mp hxQM
    refine ⟨⟨m⁻¹, M.inv_mem hm⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hqmx]
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hq
  let rep : CoatomFiber M V → M := fun Q ↦ Classical.choose (exists_rep Q)
  have rep_mem (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : x * (rep Q : G) ∈ Q.1 :=
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_rep Q)
  have hVQ (Q : CoatomFiber M V) : V ≤ Q.1 := by
    intro v hv
    have hvInf : v ∈ Q.1 ⊓ M := by
      rw [Q.2.1]
      exact hv
    exact hvInf.1
  have generated (Q : CoatomFiber M V) :
      V ⊔ Subgroup.closure {x * (rep Q : G)} = Q.1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine sup_le (hVQ Q) ((Subgroup.closure_le Q.1).2 ?_)
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
      exact rep_mem Q
    · let R : Subgroup G := V ⊔ Subgroup.closure {x * (rep Q : G)}
      have hRQ : R ≤ Q.1 := by
        refine sup_le (hVQ Q) ((Subgroup.closure_le Q.1).2 ?_)
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hy]
        exact rep_mem Q
      have hqR : x * (rep Q : G) ∈ R :=
        Subgroup.mem_sup_right (Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _))
      have hqM : x * (rep Q : G) ∉ M := by
        intro h
        apply hxM
        have hmInv : (rep Q : G)⁻¹ ∈ M := M.inv_mem (rep Q).2
        simpa [mul_assoc] using M.mul_mem h hmInv
      have hRnot : ¬ R ≤ M := fun h ↦ hqM (h hqR)
      have hRM : R ⊔ M = ⊤ := sup_eq_top R hRnot
      intro y hy
      have hyRM : y ∈ R ⊔ M := by
        rw [hRM]
        exact Subgroup.mem_top y
      obtain ⟨r, hr, m, hm, hrmy⟩ :=
        (Subgroup.mem_sup_of_normal_right (s := R) (t := M) (x := y)).mp hyRM
      have hmQ : m ∈ Q.1 := by
        have hm_eq : m = r⁻¹ * y := by
          rw [← hrmy]
          simp
        rw [hm_eq]
        exact Q.1.mul_mem (Q.1.inv_mem (hRQ hr)) hy
      have hmV : m ∈ V := by
        rw [← Q.2.1]
        exact ⟨hmQ, hm⟩
      have hmR : m ∈ R := Subgroup.mem_sup_left hmV
      rw [← hrmy]
      exact R.mul_mem hr hmR
  let f : CoatomFiber M V → M ⧸ V.subgroupOf M := fun Q ↦ QuotientGroup.mk (rep Q)
  have fiber_le (A B : CoatomFiber M V) (hf : f A = f B) : B.1 ≤ A.1 := by
    rw [← generated B]
    refine sup_le (hVQ A) ((Subgroup.closure_le A.1).2 ?_)
    rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    have hvM : (rep A)⁻¹ * rep B ∈ V.subgroupOf M := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hf
    have hv : (rep A : G)⁻¹ * (rep B : G) ∈ V := Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf.mp hvM
    have hvA : (rep A : G)⁻¹ * (rep B : G) ∈ A.1 := hVQ A hv
    have hprod := A.1.mul_mem (rep_mem A) hvA
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hprod
  have hf_injective : Function.Injective f := by
    intro A B hf
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact le_antisymm (fiber_le B A hf.symm) (fiber_le A B hf)
  calc
    Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) ≤ Fintype.card (M ⧸ V.subgroupOf M) :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf_injective
    _ = V.relIndex M := by
      rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
      rfl

/-- Subgroups between `T` and `P` having index `p^k` in `P`. -/
def primePowerLayer (p k : ℕ) (T P : Subgroup G) : Finset (Subgroup G) :=
  by
    classical
    exact Finset.univ.filter fun Q ↦ T ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧ Q.relIndex P = p ^ k

@[simp]
theorem mem_primePowerLayer {p k : ℕ} {T P Q : Subgroup G} :
    Q ∈ primePowerLayer p k T P ↔ T ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ P ∧ Q.relIndex P = p ^ k := by
  simp [primePowerLayer]

/-- Passing from an ambient subgroup `P` to the group `P` itself preserves every relative-index
layer. -/
theorem primePowerLayer_card_subgroup {p k : ℕ} {T P : Subgroup G} (hTP : T ≤ P) :
    (primePowerLayer p k T P).card =
      (primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P)).card := by
  classical
  let toSubgroup (Q : ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P)) :
      ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P)) := by
    refine ⟨Q.1.subgroupOf P, ?_⟩
    have hQ := (mem_primePowerLayer.mp Q.2)
    apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
    refine ⟨Subgroup.comap_mono hQ.1, le_top, ?_⟩
    simpa using
      (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := Q.1) (K := P) (L := P) le_rfl).trans hQ.2.2
  let fromSubgroup (R : ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P))) :
      ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P) := by
    refine ⟨R.1.map P.subtype, ?_⟩
    have hR := mem_primePowerLayer.mp R.2
    apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, Subgroup.map_subtype_le R.1, ?_⟩
    · calc
        T = Subgroup.map P.subtype (T.subgroupOf P) :=
          (Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le hTP).symm
        _ ≤ Subgroup.map P.subtype R.1 := Subgroup.map_mono hR.1
    · have hi := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective R.1 (⊤ : Subgroup P)
          P.subtype_injective
      have htop : Subgroup.map P.subtype (⊤ : Subgroup P) = P := by
        rw [← P.subtype.range_eq_map, Subgroup.range_subtype]
      rw [htop] at hi
      exact hi.trans hR.2.2
  have hleft (Q : ↑(primePowerLayer p k T P)) : fromSubgroup (toSubgroup Q) = Q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le (mem_primePowerLayer.mp Q.2).2.1
  have hright (R : ↑(primePowerLayer p k (T.subgroupOf P) (⊤ : Subgroup P))) :
      toSubgroup (fromSubgroup R) = R := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective P.subtype_injective R.1
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe, ← Fintype.card_coe]
  exact Fintype.card_congr
    { toFun := toSubgroup
      invFun := fromSubgroup
      left_inv := hleft
      right_inv := hright }

/-- The Gaussian layer bound for an arbitrary subgroup of a finite `p`-group. -/
theorem pGroup_primePowerLayer_card_le {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hG : IsPGroup p G)
    (T : Subgroup G) (hindex : T.index = p ^ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (primePowerLayer p k T ⊤).card ≤ qBinom p a k := by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  induction a generalizing G T k with
  | zero =>
      have hT : T = ⊤ := Subgroup.index_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hindex)
      subst T
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have hlayer : primePowerLayer p 0 (⊤ : Subgroup G) ⊤ = {⊤} := by
            ext Q
            constructor
            · intro hQ
              have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQ
              exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
                (top_unique (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hQl.2.2)))
            · intro hQ
              have hQtop := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hQ
              subst Q
              exact mem_primePowerLayer.mpr ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, by simp⟩
          simp [hlayer]
      | succ k =>
          have hpow : p ^ (k + 1) ≠ 1 := by
            exact (Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hp.one_lt).ne'
          simp [primePowerLayer, hpow, hpow.symm]
  | succ a ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          have hlayer : primePowerLayer p 0 T ⊤ = {⊤} := by
            ext Q
            constructor
            · intro hQ
              have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQ
              exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr
                (top_unique (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp (by simpa using hQl.2.2)))
            · intro hQ
              have hQtop := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hQ
              subst Q
              exact mem_primePowerLayer.mpr ⟨le_top, le_rfl, by simp⟩
          simp [hlayer]
      | succ k =>
          obtain ⟨b, hTcard⟩ := (hG.to_subgroup T).exists_card_eq
          have hcardG : Nat.card G = p ^ (b + (a + 1)) := by
            rw [← T.card_mul_index, hTcard, hindex, ← pow_add]
          have hdvd : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card G := by
            rw [hcardG, show b + (a + 1) = (b + a) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
            exact dvd_mul_right _ _
          obtain ⟨M, hMcard, hTM⟩ :=
            Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime_le (G := G) p hdvd T hTcard (by omega)
          have hMindex : M.index = p := by
            apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (pow_pos hp.pos _)
            calc
              p ^ (b + a) * M.index = Nat.card G := by
                rw [← hMcard]
                exact M.card_mul_index
              _ = p ^ (b + a) * p := by
                rw [hcardG, show b + (a + 1) = (b + a) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
          letI : M.Normal := normal_of_index_eq_prime_of_isPGroup hp hG M hMindex
          have hMcoatom : IsCoatom M := isCoatom_of_prime_index M (hMindex.symm ▸ hp)
          have hTrelM : T.relIndex M = p ^ a := by
            have htower := T.relIndex_mul_index hTM
            apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
            simpa [hMindex, hindex, pow_succ] using htower
          let layer := primePowerLayer p (k + 1) T ⊤
          let inside := layer.filter fun Q ↦ Q ≤ M
          let outside := layer.filter fun Q ↦ ¬Q ≤ M
          have hsplit : inside.card + outside.card = layer.card := by
            exact Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := layer) (fun Q ↦ Q ≤ M)
          let lowerLayer := primePowerLayer p k T M
          have hins_maps : (inside : Set (Subgroup G)) ⊆ (lowerLayer : Set (Subgroup G)) := by
            intro Q hQ
            have hQi := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ
            have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQi.1
            apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
            refine ⟨hQl.1, hQi.2, ?_⟩
            have htower := Q.relIndex_mul_index hQi.2
            apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
            calc
              Q.relIndex M * p = Q.index := by
                rw [← hMindex]
                exact htower
              _ = p ^ (k + 1) := by
                rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
                exact hQl.2.2
              _ = p ^ k * p := by rw [pow_succ]
          have hlower : lowerLayer.card ≤ qBinom p a k := by
            rw [primePowerLayer_card_subgroup hTM]
            exact ih (G := M) (hG.to_subgroup M) (T.subgroupOf M) (by
              simpa using
                (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := T) (K := M) (L := M) le_rfl).trans hTrelM) k
          have hinside : inside.card ≤ qBinom p a k :=
            (Finset.card_le_card hins_maps).trans hlower
          let upperLayer := primePowerLayer p (k + 1) T M
          have hout_maps : (outside : Set (Subgroup G)).MapsTo (fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M) upperLayer := by
            intro Q hQ
            have hQo := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQ
            have hQl := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hQo.1
            have hsup : M ⊔ Q = ⊤ := by
              apply hMcoatom.2
              refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left ?_
              intro heq
              exact hQo.2 (le_sup_right.trans_eq heq.symm)
            have hVrelQ : (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q = p := by
              calc
                (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q = M.relIndex Q := by
                  simpa [inf_comm] using M.inf_relIndex_right Q
                _ = M.relIndex (M ⊔ Q) := (Q.relIndex_sup_left M).symm
                _ = p := by rw [hsup, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right, hMindex]
            have hVrelM : (Q ⊓ M).relIndex M = p ^ (k + 1) := by
              have htowerM := (Q ⊓ M).relIndex_mul_index inf_le_right
              have htowerQ := (Q ⊓ M).relIndex_mul_index inf_le_left
              have hQindex : Q.index = p ^ (k + 1) := by
                rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
                exact hQl.2.2
              apply Nat.mul_right_cancel hp.pos
              calc
                (Q ⊓ M).relIndex M * p = (Q ⊓ M).index := by
                  simpa [hMindex] using htowerM
                _ = (Q ⊓ M).relIndex Q * Q.index := htowerQ.symm
                _ = p * p ^ (k + 1) := by rw [hVrelQ, hQindex]
                _ = p ^ (k + 1) * p := by ac_rfl
            apply mem_primePowerLayer.mpr
            exact ⟨le_inf hQl.1 hTM, inf_le_right, hVrelM⟩
          have houtside : outside.card ≤ p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) := by
            rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hout_maps]
            calc
              ∑ V ∈ upperLayer, (outside.filter fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M = V).card ≤
                  ∑ _V ∈ upperLayer, p ^ (k + 1) := by
                    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
                    intro V hV
                    let actualFiber := outside.filter fun Q ↦ Q ⊓ M = V
                    let embed (Q : ↑actualFiber) : CoatomFiber M V := by
                      have hQf := Finset.mem_filter.mp Q.2
                      have hQo := Finset.mem_filter.mp hQf.1
                      exact ⟨Q.1, hQf.2, hQo.2⟩
                    have hembed : Function.Injective embed := by
                      intro Q R hQR
                      apply Subtype.ext
                      exact congrArg (fun X : CoatomFiber M V ↦ X.1) hQR
                    have hactual : actualFiber.card ≤ Fintype.card (CoatomFiber M V) := by
                      rw [← Fintype.card_coe]
                      exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective embed hembed
                    have hVmem := mem_primePowerLayer.mp hV
                    exact hactual.trans
                      ((coatomFiber_card_le_relIndex M V hMcoatom hVmem.2.1).trans_eq
                        hVmem.2.2)
              _ = upperLayer.card * p ^ (k + 1) :=
                    Finset.sum_const_nat fun _ _ ↦ rfl
              _ ≤ qBinom p a (k + 1) * p ^ (k + 1) := by
                    gcongr
                    rw [primePowerLayer_card_subgroup hTM]
                    exact ih (G := M) (hG.to_subgroup M) (T.subgroupOf M) (by
                      simpa using
                        (Subgroup.relIndex_subgroupOf (H := T) (K := M) (L := M)
                          le_rfl).trans hTrelM) (k + 1)
              _ = p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) := by ac_rfl
          rw [← hsplit]
          calc
            inside.card + outside.card ≤
                qBinom p a k + p ^ (k + 1) * qBinom p a (k + 1) :=
              Nat.add_le_add hinside houtside
            _ = qBinom p (a + 1) (k + 1) := (qBinom_succ_succ p a k).symm

/-- If `[G:H]` is a power of `p`, a Sylow `p`-subgroup of `G` can be chosen so that its
action on `G/H` is transitive.  Its stabilizer has exactly the same prime-power index. -/
theorem exists_sylow_pretransitive_of_index_primePower {p a : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hindex : H.index = p ^ a) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G,
      MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) ∧ H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ a := by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let S : Sylow p H := Sylow.nonempty.some
  obtain ⟨P, hPcomap⟩ := S.exists_comap_subtype_eq
  obtain ⟨b, hScard⟩ := S.2.exists_card_eq
  let e : H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G) ≃ S :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ by
        let y : H := ⟨(x.1 : G), x.2⟩
        refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
        rw [← hPcomap]
        exact x.1.2
      invFun := fun y ↦ by
        have hyP : (y.1 : G) ∈ (P : Subgroup G) := by
          have : y.1 ∈ P.comap H.subtype := by simpa [hPcomap] using y.2
          exact this
        exact ⟨⟨(y.1 : G), hyP⟩, y.1.2⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; ext; rfl
      right_inv := by intro y; ext; rfl }
  have hinterCard : Nat.card (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) = p ^ b := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr e, hScard]
  have hPcard_tower :
      Nat.card (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)) * H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = Nat.card P := by
    exact (H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G)).card_mul_index
  have hrel_le : H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) ≤ H.index := by
    simpa using H.relIndex_le_of_le_right (K := (P : Subgroup G)) (L := ⊤) le_top
      Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
  have hPcard_le : Nat.card P ≤ p ^ (b + a) := by
    rw [← hPcard_tower, hinterCard, pow_add]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hrel_le.trans_eq hindex)
  have hpow_dvd_cardG : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card G := by
    refine ⟨S.index, ?_⟩
    calc
      Nat.card G = Nat.card H * H.index := H.card_mul_index.symm
      _ = (Nat.card S * S.index) * p ^ a := by rw [hindex, S.card_mul_index]
      _ = p ^ (b + a) * S.index := by rw [hScard, pow_add]; ac_rfl
  have hpow_dvd_cardP : p ^ (b + a) ∣ Nat.card P :=
    P.pow_dvd_card_of_pow_dvd_card hpow_dvd_cardG
  have hPcard : Nat.card P = p ^ (b + a) := by
    apply le_antisymm hPcard_le
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd Nat.card_pos hpow_dvd_cardP
  have hrel : H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ a := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (pow_pos hp.pos _)
    calc
      p ^ b * H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) = Nat.card P := by
        rw [← hinterCard]
        exact hPcard_tower
      _ = p ^ b * p ^ a := by rw [hPcard, pow_add]
  have hstab :
      MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = H.subgroupOf (P : Subgroup G) := by
    ext g
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    have hsmul : g • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((g : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq]
    simp only [mul_one, Subgroup.inv_mem_iff, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
  have horbit : MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = Set.univ :=
    (Set.eq_univ_iff_ncard (MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H))).2 <| by
        calc
          (MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).ncard =
              (MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).index :=
            (MulAction.index_stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)).symm
          _ = H.relIndex (P : Subgroup G) := by rw [hstab]; rfl
          _ = p ^ a := hrel
          _ = Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by rw [← H.index_eq_card, hindex]
  have hpre : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := ⟨by
    intro y z
    have hy : y ∈ MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := by rw [horbit]; trivial
    have hz : z ∈ MulAction.orbit P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := by rw [horbit]; trivial
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨s * r⁻¹, ?_⟩
    rw [← hr, ← hs]
    simp [smul_smul]⟩
  exact ⟨P, hpre, hrel⟩

/-- Transitivity on `G/H` descends to every quotient `G/K` with `H ≤ K`. -/
theorem pretransitive_quotient_of_le {P H K : Subgroup G}
    (hpre : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H)) (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ K) := by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := hpre
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rintro ⟨g⟩ ⟨g'⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp'⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq P ((g : G) : G ⧸ H) ((g' : G) : G ⧸ H)
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  apply QuotientGroup.eq.mpr
  exact hHK (QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp')

/-- Under a transitive `P`-action on `G/H`, intersection with `P` preserves all later indices. -/
theorem relIndex_eq_index_of_pretransitive {P H K : Subgroup G}
    (hpre : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H)) (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    K.relIndex P = K.index := by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ K) := pretransitive_quotient_of_le hpre hHK
  have hstab :
      MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = K.subgroupOf P := by
    ext g
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    have hsmul : g • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = (((g : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ K) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one, QuotientGroup.eq]
    simp only [mul_one, Subgroup.inv_mem_iff, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
  calc
    K.relIndex P = (K.subgroupOf P).index := rfl
    _ = (MulAction.stabilizer P ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K)).index := by rw [hstab]
    _ = Nat.card (G ⧸ K) := MulAction.index_stabilizer_of_transitive P _
    _ = K.index := rfl

/-- A subgroup containing `H` is determined by its intersection with a subgroup acting
transitively on `G/H`. -/
theorem subgroupOf_injective_of_pretransitive {P H : Subgroup G}
    (hpre : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H)) :
    Set.InjOn (fun K : Subgroup G ↦ K.subgroupOf P) (Set.Ici H) := by
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive P (G ⧸ H) := hpre
  intro K hHK L hHL heq
  change K.subgroupOf P = L.subgroupOf P at heq
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hgK
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
      MulAction.exists_smul_eq P (((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)) ((g : G) : G ⧸ H)
    have hsmul : p • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((p : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one] at hp
    have hpgH : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ H := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp
    have hpgK : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ K := hHK hpgH
    have hpK : (p : G) ∈ K := by
      have := K.mul_mem hgK (K.inv_mem hpgK)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    have hpL : (p : G) ∈ L := by
      have hpSub : p ∈ K.subgroupOf P := hpK
      rw [heq] at hpSub
      exact hpSub
    have hpgL : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ L := hHL hpgH
    have := L.mul_mem hpL hpgL
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this
  · intro g hgL
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
      MulAction.exists_smul_eq P (((1 : G) : G ⧸ H)) ((g : G) : G ⧸ H)
    have hsmul : p • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ H) = (((p : G) * 1 : G) : G ⧸ H) := rfl
    rw [hsmul, mul_one] at hp
    have hpgH : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ H := QuotientGroup.eq.mp hp
    have hpgL : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ L := hHL hpgH
    have hpL : (p : G) ∈ L := by
      have := L.mul_mem hgL (L.inv_mem hpgL)
      simpa [mul_assoc] using this
    have hpK : (p : G) ∈ K := by
      have hpSub : p ∈ L.subgroupOf P := hpL
      rw [← heq] at hpSub
      exact hpSub
    have hpgK : (p : G)⁻¹ * g ∈ K := hHK hpgH
    have := K.mul_mem hpK hpgK
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this

-- [Emissary prelude] SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds.QBinomial — verbatim (imports stripped)
namespace SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The Gaussian binomial coefficient `n choose k` with parameter `q`.

The chosen recurrence is
`[n+1,k+1]_q = [n,k]_q + q^(k+1) [n,k+1]_q`, the form used by the
prime-power layer argument. -/
def qBinom (q : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | _ + 1, 0 => 1
  | n + 1, k + 1 => qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)

@[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_zero (q : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_zero_succ (q k : ℕ) : qBinom q 0 (k + 1) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_zero (q n : ℕ) : qBinom q (n + 1) 0 = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem qBinom_succ_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    qBinom q (n + 1) (k + 1) =
      qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1) := rfl

theorem qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (q : ℕ) : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → qBinom q n k = 0
  | 0, 0, h => by omega
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by simp
  | _ + 1, 0, h => by omega
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      have hnk : n < k := by omega
      have hnks : n < k + 1 := by omega
      simp [qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnk, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hnks]

@[simp] theorem qBinom_self (q : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, qBinom q n n = 1
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [qBinom_succ_succ]
      simp [qBinom_self q n, qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]

/-- The Pascal recurrence in the indexing used in the manuscript. -/
theorem qBinom_pascal (q : ℕ) {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q (n - 1) (k - 1) + q ^ k * qBinom q (n - 1) k := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
  simpa using qBinom_succ_succ q n k

/-- The product `(q-1)(q²-1)⋯(qⁿ-1)`. -/
def qFactorial (q n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (q ^ (i + 1) - 1)

@[simp] theorem qFactorial_zero (q : ℕ) : qFactorial q 0 = 1 := by
  simp [qFactorial]

theorem qFactorial_succ (q n : ℕ) :
    qFactorial q (n + 1) = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
  simp [qFactorial, Finset.prod_range_succ]

theorem qFactorial_pos {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (n : ℕ) : 0 < qFactorial q n := by
  rw [qFactorial]
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i hi ↦ by
    have hiq : 1 < q ^ (i + 1) := by
      exact one_lt_pow₀ (by omega) (by omega)
    omega

private theorem pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one {q a b : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    (q ^ a - 1) + q ^ a * (q ^ b - 1) = q ^ (a + b) - 1 := by
  have ha : 1 ≤ q ^ a := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hb : 1 ≤ q ^ b := one_le_pow₀ hq
  have hab : q ^ a ≤ q ^ a * q ^ b := by
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (q ^ a) hb
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, mul_one, add_comm]
  exact tsub_add_tsub_cancel hab ha

/-- The division-free Gaussian factorial identity. -/
theorem qBinom_mul_qFactorials {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n →
      qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) = qFactorial q n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have : k = 0 := by omega
      subst k
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k =>
          have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
          by_cases htop : k = n
          · subst k
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qBinom_self,
              qBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (Nat.lt_succ_self n)]
            simp [qFactorial_succ]
          · have hklt : k < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hkn htop
            have hk1 : k + 1 ≤ n := by omega
            have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
            rw [qBinom_succ_succ, qFactorial_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, hsub,
              qFactorial_succ]
            calc
              (qBinom q n k + q ^ (k + 1) * qBinom q n (k + 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q k * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1)) *
                    (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - (k + 1) + 1) - 1)) =
                  (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) *
                      (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) *
                      (qBinom q n (k + 1) * qFactorial q (k + 1) *
                        qFactorial q (n - (k + 1))) *
                      (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                        rw [qFactorial_succ, hsub, qFactorial_succ]
                        ring
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                    q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
                      rw [ih hkn, ih hk1]
              _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
                    have hexp : k + 1 + (n - k) = n + 1 := by omega
                    calc
                      qFactorial q n * (q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                          q ^ (k + 1) * qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) =
                          qFactorial q n * ((q ^ (k + 1) - 1) +
                            q ^ (k + 1) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) := by ring
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ ((k + 1) + (n - k)) - 1) := by
                        rw [pow_sub_one_add_mul_pow_sub_one (by omega)]
                      _ = qFactorial q n * (q ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by rw [hexp]
              _ = qFactorial q (n + 1) := by rw [qFactorial_succ]

/-- Symmetry of Gaussian binomial coefficients. -/
theorem qBinom_symm {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k = qBinom q n (n - k) := by
  have hleft := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  have hright := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq (Nat.sub_le n k)
  rw [tsub_tsub_cancel_of_le hk] at hright
  have hden : 0 < qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) :=
    Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hden
  calc
    qBinom q n k * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) = qFactorial q n := by
      simpa [mul_assoc] using hleft
    _ = qBinom q n (n - k) * (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
      simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hright.symm

/-- The usual product formula, stated in `ℚ` to make the division exact. -/
theorem qBinom_cast_eq_qFactorial_div {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) =
      qFactorial q n / (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
  have hden : (qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt
      (Nat.mul_pos (qFactorial_pos hq k) (qFactorial_pos hq (n - k))))
  apply (eq_div_iff hden).2
  simpa [mul_assoc] using (show
    (qBinom q n k : ℚ) * (qFactorial q k : ℚ) *
      (qFactorial q (n - k) : ℚ) = (qFactorial q n : ℚ) by
        exact_mod_cast qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk)



/-- Ordered linearly independent `k`-frames in a module. -/
abbrev LinearIndependentFrames (K V : Type*) [Semiring K] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module K V]
    (k : ℕ) :=
  {s : Fin k → V // LinearIndependent K s}

/-- The type of `k`-dimensional subspaces. -/
abbrev FinrankSubspaces (K V : Type*) [Semiring K] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module K V]
    (k : ℕ) :=
  {W : Submodule K V // Module.finrank K W = k}

private theorem span_coe_frame_eq_submodule
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (k : ℕ) (W : Submodule K V) (s : Fin k → W)
    (hs : LinearIndependent K s) (hW : Module.finrank K W = k) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ (s i : V)) = W := by
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range s) = ⊤ :=
    hs.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by simp [hW])
  change Submodule.span K (Set.range (W.subtype ∘ s)) = W
  rw [Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span, htop, Submodule.map_top,
    Submodule.range_subtype]

/-- A linearly independent frame is equivalently a subspace together with a
linearly independent frame which spans that subspace. -/
noncomputable def linearIndependentFramesEquiv
    (K V : Type*) [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (k : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependentFrames K V k ≃
      Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k := by
  let forward : LinearIndependentFrames K V k →
      Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k := fun s ↦
    ⟨⟨Submodule.span K (Set.range s.1), by
        simpa using finrank_span_eq_card s.2⟩,
      ⟨fun i ↦ ⟨s.1 i, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩,
        linearIndependent_span s.2⟩⟩
  let backward : (Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
      LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) → LinearIndependentFrames K V k := fun x ↦
    ⟨fun i ↦ (x.2.1 i : V),
      x.2.2.map' x.1.1.subtype (Submodule.ker_subtype x.1.1)⟩
  refine Equiv.ofBijective forward ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s t hst
    have := congrArg backward hst
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val this)
  · intro x
    refine ⟨backward x, ?_⟩
    rcases x with ⟨W, s⟩
    have hfirst : (forward (backward ⟨W, s⟩)).1 = W :=
      Subtype.ext (span_coe_frame_eq_submodule k W.1 s.1 s.2 W.2)
    have hsub :
        Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ ((s.1 i : W.1) : V)) = W.1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hfirst
    apply Sigma.ext hfirst
    simp only [forward, backward]
    apply (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_heq ?_ ?_).2
    · apply Function.hfunext rfl
      intro i j hij
      have hij' : i = j := eq_of_heq hij
      subst j
      apply (Subtype.heq_iff_coe_eq ?_).2
      · rfl
      · intro x
        change x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i ↦ ((s.1 i : W.1) : V)) ↔ x ∈ W.1
        rw [hsub]
    · exact congrArg (fun U : Submodule K V ↦ Fin k → U) hsub
    · apply Function.hfunext
        (congrArg (fun U : Submodule K V ↦ Fin k → U) hsub)
      intro x y hxy
      congr! 2
      funext z
      rw [hsub]

/-- The number of ordered independent `k`-frames in an `n`-dimensional
vector space over a field of cardinality `q`. -/
def frameProd (q n k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ i : Fin k, (q ^ n - q ^ i.val)

@[simp] theorem frameProd_zero (q n : ℕ) : frameProd q n 0 = 1 := by
  simp [frameProd]

theorem frameProd_succ (q n k : ℕ) :
    frameProd q n (k + 1) = frameProd q n k * (q ^ n - q ^ k) := by
  rw [frameProd, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [frameProd]

/-- The product of the powers of `q` which are factored out of an ordered
frame count. -/
def framePower (q k : ℕ) : ℕ := ∏ i : Fin k, q ^ i.val

@[simp] theorem framePower_zero (q : ℕ) : framePower q 0 = 1 := by
  simp [framePower]

theorem framePower_succ (q k : ℕ) :
    framePower q (k + 1) = framePower q k * q ^ k := by
  rw [framePower, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
  simp [framePower]

private theorem pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    q ^ n - q ^ k = q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [show n = k + (n - k) by omega]
  rw [pow_add, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
  simp

/-- Clearing the denominator in the ordered-frame product formula. -/
theorem frameProd_mul_qFactorial {q n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
      framePower q k * qFactorial q n := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
      have hsub : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
      rw [frameProd_succ, pow_sub_pow_eq_mul_sub hkn, framePower_succ]
      calc
        frameProd q n k * (q ^ k * (q ^ (n - k) - 1)) *
              qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) =
            q ^ k * (frameProd q n k *
              (qFactorial q (n - (k + 1)) * (q ^ (n - k) - 1))) := by ring
        _ = q ^ k * (frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
          rw [hsub, qFactorial_succ]
        _ = q ^ k * (framePower q k * qFactorial q n) := by rw [ih hkn]
        _ = framePower q k * q ^ k * qFactorial q n := by ring

/-- The ordered-frame form of the Gaussian product identity. -/
theorem qBinom_mul_frameProd {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k = frameProd q n k := by
  have hmain := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := n) hk
  have hdiag := frameProd_mul_qFactorial (q := q) (n := k) (le_refl k)
  have hqbin := qBinom_mul_qFactorials hq hk
  simp only [Nat.sub_self, qFactorial_zero, mul_one] at hdiag
  have hcancel : 0 < qFactorial q (n - k) := qFactorial_pos hq _
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hcancel
  calc
    qBinom q n k * frameProd q k k * qFactorial q (n - k) =
        framePower q k *
          (qBinom q n k * qFactorial q k * qFactorial q (n - k)) := by
            rw [hdiag]
            ring
    _ = framePower q k * qFactorial q n := by rw [hqbin]
    _ = frameProd q n k * qFactorial q (n - k) := hmain.symm

theorem frameProd_pos {q n k : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    0 < frameProd q n k := by
  rw [frameProd]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i hi
  have hik : i.val < k := i.isLt
  have hin : i.val < n := lt_of_lt_of_le hik hk
  exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hin)

theorem card_linearIndependentFrames
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  simpa [frameProd] using card_linearIndependent (K := K) (V := V) hk

/-- The exact number of ordered bases of the standard `r`-space over
`ZMod p`, expressed as the ordered-frame product. -/
theorem card_orderedBases_fin_zmod (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames (ZMod p) (Fin r → ZMod p) r) =
      frameProd p r r := by
  simpa using
    (card_linearIndependentFrames
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin r → ZMod p) (k := r) (by simp))

/-- Counting independent frames by their span. -/
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
      frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  letI : Fintype (FinrankSubspaces K V k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k, frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    _ = ∑ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro W hW
        symm
        simpa [W.2] using
          (card_linearIndependentFrames (K := K) (V := W.1) (k := k)
            (by simp [W.2]))
    _ = Nat.card (Σ W : FinrankSubspaces K V k,
          LinearIndependentFrames K W.1 k) := Nat.card_sigma.symm
    _ = Nat.card (LinearIndependentFrames K V k) :=
      Nat.card_congr (linearIndependentFramesEquiv K V k).symm
    _ = frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_linearIndependentFrames hk

/-- The Gaussian coefficient counts subspaces of a fixed dimension over any
finite division ring. -/
theorem card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
    {K V : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [Fintype K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [Finite V] {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ Module.finrank K V) :
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) =
      qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k := by
  have hq : 2 ≤ Fintype.card K := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hpos : 0 < frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := frameProd_pos hq le_rfl
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hpos
  calc
    Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces K V k) * frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k =
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k :=
      card_finrankSubspaces_mul_frameProd hk
    _ = qBinom (Fintype.card K) (Module.finrank K V) k *
        frameProd (Fintype.card K) k k := (qBinom_mul_frameProd hq hk).symm

/-- Exact Gaussian count for subspaces of the standard `n`-space over
`ZMod p`. -/
theorem card_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hk : k ≤ n) :
    Nat.card {W : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) //
      Module.finrank (ZMod p) W = k} = qBinom p n k := by
  simpa using
    (card_finrankSubspaces_eq_qBinom
      (K := ZMod p) (V := Fin n → ZMod p) (k := k) (by simpa using hk))

/-- A subspace together with its dimension, bounded by the ambient
dimension. -/
noncomputable def submoduleEquivSigmaFinrank
    (K V : Type*) [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] :
    Submodule K V ≃
      Σ k : Fin (Module.finrank K V + 1), FinrankSubspaces K V k.val where
  toFun W := ⟨⟨Module.finrank K W, Nat.lt_succ_of_le W.finrank_le⟩, ⟨W, rfl⟩⟩
  invFun x := x.2.1
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv x := by
    rcases x with ⟨k, W⟩
    rcases W with ⟨W, hW⟩
    have hk : (⟨Module.finrank K W, Nat.lt_succ_of_le W.finrank_le⟩ :
        Fin (Module.finrank K V + 1)) = k := Fin.ext hW
    cases hk
    rfl

/-- The total Gaussian sum. -/
def totalQBinom (q n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), qBinom q n k.val

/-- Pairing dimensions equidistant from the middle in even rank. -/
theorem totalQBinom_even_split {q : ℕ} (hq : 2 ≤ q) (a : ℕ) :
    totalQBinom q (2 * a) = qBinom q (2 * a) a +
      2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, qBinom q (2 * a) (a + (j + 1)) := by
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun k ↦ qBinom q (2 * a) k
  have hlow : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f j) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a - 1 - j) :=
        (Finset.sum_range_reflect f a).symm
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range a, f (a + (j + 1)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        have hja : j < a := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        dsimp [f]
        rw [qBinom_symm hq (by omega : a - 1 - j ≤ 2 * a)]
        congr 1
        omega
  rw [totalQBinom, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  have hsize : 2 * a + 1 = (a + 1) + a := by omega
  rw [hsize, Finset.sum_range_add, Finset.sum_range_succ, hlow]
  dsimp [f]
  simp only [Nat.add_assoc]
  ring

/-- Exact count of all subspaces of the standard space over `ZMod p`. -/
theorem card_all_subspaces_fin_zmod (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    Nat.card (Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)) = totalQBinom p n := by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (submoduleEquivSigmaFinrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p)),
    Nat.card_sigma]
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) = n := by simp
  rw [hfin]
  have hsum :
      (∑ k : Fin (n + 1), Nat.card (FinrankSubspaces (ZMod p) (Fin n → ZMod p) k.val)) =
        ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), qBinom p n k.val := by
    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro k
    exact card_subspaces_fin_zmod p n k.val (by omega)
  simpa only [totalQBinom] using hsum

end SharpIntermediateSubgroupBounds
